style.vernacular: Hot savanna river city on the Benue and Gongola: the old Yola town of red-earth mud-render compounds with grey thatch or corrugated zinc roofs around the Lamido's palace, and the newer commercial Jimeta with 1-4 storey cement-render shops, banks and apartment blocks in cream, ochre and white, flat concrete roofs, corrugated metal sheds and open laterite ground.
style.ornament: Fulani/Hausa geometric relief and crenellated parapets on palace and compound walls, mosque domes and semi-elliptical arches with calligraphy, cement-rendered gates; very little ornament on commercial blocks.

sources.what: sandstone ridge, red earth, mud huts, grey thatch (1893 account); tropical savanna bordering hot semi-arid; Jimeta is the new commercial centre
tropical wet-and-dry climate, savanna vegetation, Fombina Palace Museum listed
palace complex has mud-brick design reflecting Fulani heritage; Jimeta Modern Market is a busy stall-filled commercial hub
